## Pause, resume, or delete one schedule

Three things only. Changing what a schedule does, or when, is
`create_schedule` again with the same name — it replaces the row rather
than adding a second one.

Pause keeps the row and stops it firing. Resume works the next run out
from now, so a schedule left off for a fortnight does not go off the
moment it comes back. Delete cannot be undone.
